milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce sapling is placed at spawn-relative (-3, 0, -3). The player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they have located it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the sapling.

Uses inventory_has because mining a spruce trapdoor always drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The trapdoor is at (-5, 1, -2) and when broken with the iron axe it will appear in inventory. This is the most direct and reliable check for a mine task where the block drops itself.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block') because mining birch leaves does NOT reliably drop a leaf block into inventory — leaves typically drop saplings, sticks, or nothing when broken without Silk Touch. Instead, we verify that at least some birch_leaves blocks have been removed from the canopy. The birch leaves span from (3,3,1) to (7,6,5) in spawn-relative coords. The original scene has approximately 48+ birch_leaves blocks; setting max_count=45 ensures at least a few have been mined.

Uses inventory_has because mining birch_wood (the all-bark block variant) always drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The birch wood trunk spans (5, 0-4, 3) with an additional block at (5, 5, 3). Mining any of these blocks with the iron axe will place birch_wood in inventory. This is the most direct and reliable verification.
